services.name: Campsite
services.desc: The Park opens April 15th to October 31st for each Camping Season. We are accepting reservations year round and into the next year! With 62 years of experience in providing exceptional outdoor experiences, we’re evolving to offer a fresh and exciting getaway for all.Discover the new and improved amenities under our new management, designed to enhance your camping experience. View Amenities Make your camping reservations as early as you can as the park can fill quickly during the times of these extremely big events happening in downtown Ottawa (just a short drive from Camp Hither Hills) Our new online campground booking system is quick, easy and convenient. Plan and Book your reservation
